The '''Ferijia system''' was a part of the [[Arrowhead]] region in [[The Slice/Legends|the Slice]] portion of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]].<ref name="TEA" /> It was the origin point of the article of [[Clothing/Legends|clothing]] known as the [[Ferijian ape suit]].<ref name="Journal9">{{JournalCite|9|Easy Credits}}</ref><ref name="Planetnamia">{{Planetnamia|other=the [[Ferijian ape suit]]|system=Ferijia [[Star system/Legends|system]]|legends=1}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
The Ferijia [[Star system/Legends|system]]&mdash;misspelled as the "Ferjia" system&mdash;was first mentioned in the [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed it in grid square M-10.<ref name="TEA" /> The [[StarWars.com]] [[Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion|Online Companion]] to the book later corrected the misspelled name.<ref name="EAOC">{{SW|url=news/star-wars-the-essential-atlas-online-companion|text=''Star Wars: The Essential Atlas'' Online Companion|int=Star Wars: The Essential Atlas Online Companion}}</ref>
